post.summary: generate a console access token for a Instance
post.description: Issues a short-lived (120s) JWT the frontend uses to open the console WebSocket directly on the worker. The token carries `console:read`, plus `console:write` when the user has that permission. Requires `instance:console:read`. Console tokens are validated independently by the worker: manager logout/reset prevents new token issuance with old access JWTs but does not revoke previously issued console tokens or disconnect existing sockets.
